DEGREE: 0–25=WNL | 26–40=Mild | 41–55=Moderate | 56–70=Mod.Severe | 71–90=Severe | 91+=Profound
TYMP ECV: Kids 0.3–0.9 | Adults 0.9–2.0 COMPLIANCE: Kids 0.3–1.0 | Adults 0.3–1.7 PRESSURE: -150 to +50 daPa
SRT–PTA: Within ±10 dB WRS: 90-100%=WNL | 75-90%=Slight | 60-75%=Moderate | 50-60%=Poor | <50%=Very poor
REFLEX SL: Normal=70-100 | Reduced=<60 (cochlear ONLY) | Elevated=>100 | SL(speech): Pres−SRT | SL(reflex): HL−AC thresh
TYPE B + Normal ECV: Middle ear pathology TYPE B + Large ECV: Perforation/PE tube TYPE B + Small ECV: Occluded canal
REFLEXES: Always air conduction ONLY
